summary: Autonomix Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing that it received a letter from Nasdaq confirming the company regained compliance with the minimum $1.00 bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company had previously been notified of a deficiency on January 14, 2026. Compliance was achieved when the closing bid price remained at or above $1.00 for ten consecutive business days from June 24 to July 8, 2026. The staff closed the matter. No special-situation event—this is a routine compliance update with no transaction, shareholder action, or structural change.
